title: Moved to dead
policy: A published v3 report that fails is never removed from the ranking in silence. It stays on RANKING.md until a dated entry is added here with a reason. Unscored pipeline names can move here for official shutdowns, unfixed exploits, wind-downs, or a documented dying-market skip. Other scan warnings such as thin volume stay warnings until they are formally moved.
dying_market_skip_rule: Market cap under $1M and 24h volume under $10k, as of a dated public market read, and only when an explicit entry is added on this list.

entries.name: DeFiChain
entries.reason: Exploit with no fix: DeFiChain's own [post](https://blog.defichain.com/2026/11/a-final-update-from-marketing-sig.html) says a 3 Nov 2026 overflow bug in account-to-account transfers created ~184.47B DFI (over 140x the ~1.3B intended max supply) and that no corrective node release or rollback will be pursued. Its only listed CEX, Bitrue, [delisted DFI](https://support.bitrue.com/hc/en-001/articles/64117793028121-Bitrue-Will-Delist-DeFiChain-DFI) (deposits and trading closed, withdrawals until 14 Nov 2026). The Marketing SIG [announced](https://t.me/s/defichain_announcements/1840) all channels and sites would close on 14 Nov 2026; on 14 Nov a community group [said](https://t.me/s/defichain_announcements/1841) it is keeping channels open and restoring sites, but no exploit fix has been announced.

entries.name: Elk Finance
entries.reason: Skipped as dying: market cap under $1M and 24h volume under $10k on 16 Nov 2026 (CoinGecko figures from the public status scan). Recorded here so a thin-market skip is not dropped silently from the pipeline.

entries.name: Giddy

entries.name: Glue

entries.name: Lisk

entries.name: RealT
entries.reason: RealT stopped most weekly distributions in Feb 2026. On 2 Jul 2026 a co-founder announced a voluntary liquidation and planned sale of the property portfolio. A formal court liquidation filing was not independently confirmed in this scan [Unverified]. DefiLlama still shows large RealT token TVL.

entries.name: Router Protocol

entries.name: Abracadabra.money Spell token
entries.reason: Official wind-down: Abracadabra's ["Refined proposal for an orderly wind down of MIM and Abracadabra"](https://snapshot.box/#/s:abracadabrabymerlinthemagician.eth/proposal/0x917c7a04fc4665028cb2701ab140462096362d22ea91137518f0ab23385776fd) closed on 15 Oct 2026 with 396.16M SPELL for, from two voters. It passed under the proposal's own 30% quorum rule; the Snapshot space's 3B quorum was not met, so the pass is disputed. The proposal says MIM is senior to SPELL and "SPELL token does not retain any accounting value" until MIM is repaid in full; recoveries go to MIM holders and borrowers, and SPELL holders get nothing.

entries.name: Qubetics
entries.reason: Qubetics L1 ceased in mid-Sep 2026 and $TICS migrated 1:1 to Ethereum. Official 6 Oct 2026 blog: the project is not commissioning further L1, chain-abstraction or dVPN development, and it burned the entire team token allocation.

entries.name: Iron Finance TITAN
entries.reason: Iron Finance TITAN famously collapsed in a June 2021 bank run. The token is still listed on CoinGecko as IRON Titanium, but the protocol is a historical failure, not an operating product.

entries.name: Tangible RWA
entries.reason: Tangible’s USDR stablecoin depegged in Oct 2023. Official Medium updates describe winding the property portfolio down through auctions and a path to a final USDR redemption.

entries.name: Neutrino USD
